acceptance: A deterministic local browser smoke test searches for a distinctive term and returns the expected documentation page.
A no-match query completes without leaving the dialog in a searching state.
Capture the worker metadata request and verify the manifest, metadata, index, and WASM assets load successfully.

context: Confirmed independently on the live production page and on the candidate static build. The exact underlying metadata failure is not yet isolated; this is a confirmed defect with an investigation action.
description: The live site search dialog opens, but a query remains stuck at ‘Searching…’ and Chromium reports `Failed to load Pagefind metadata` from `/pagefind/pagefind.js`/its worker. Reproduced on `https://benchbox.dev/blog/` on 2026-10-11. This is a user-visible search failure, separate from the targeted documentation and Atom-feed fixes. Trace the worker's metadata URL, response, and bundle configuration; fix the root cause and prove a real query returns the expected page.
